name: branch-integration
title: Branch Integration
summary: Land verified work through a user-chosen integration path with safe cleanup.

use_when: Implementation is complete and the full test suite passes on the current tree
The work needs to be merged locally, pushed as a pull request, or deliberately kept
The user explicitly asks to discard finished work
avoid_when: History, rebase, or commit planning — use git-workflow
The work is a stack of dependent PRs — use gh-stack
The completion claim has not been verified yet — use verification-before-completion first
